intro: A strong identity check combines **something you have**, like an ID card, with **something you are**, like a face or fingerprint. Our biometric devices capture the second part reliably, and work with our [e-KYC software](product:spectrum-e-kyc) to match it against the card and the NID records.

items.title: Fingerprint scanners
items.text: The customer places a finger on a scanner, and the fingerprint is matched against the NID records in the same check. Fake or rubber fingers are spotted.

items.title: Iris cameras
items.text: For sites that need extra security, or for people whose fingerprints are worn, an iris scanner can be added as a third option.

items.title: NID card readers
items.text: Read the chip and barcode on the card, so the data can be compared with the printed details and the official record.

items.title: Banks & mobile financial services
items.text: Open accounts, issue cards and approve loans with e-KYC, in a branch or on the customer's own phone.

items.title: Telecom
items.text: Register SIM cards and eSIMs with a fingerprint check at the retail counter, in seconds.

items.title: Government
items.text: Civil registration, social programme enrolment and staff identity checks, with one record per person.

items.title: Police & border control
items.text: Identity checks at checkpoints and border points, matching face and fingerprint to the card in seconds.
